say:1:1620113001:1.text: Vendors these days are getting out of hand! I've bought meat that tastes awful or even goes bad before, but never anything this nasty!
say:1:1620113001:1.source_cn: 最近那些无良摊贩真是越来越嚣张了！我买过难吃的肉、坏掉...

say:2:1620113002:1.text: It looked fresh and had a great texture... but guess what? I made a stew with it, and it had absolutely no flavor!
say:2:1620113002:1.source_cn: 看上去是鲜肉，切下来纹理也好。结果买回家一炖，别说肉香...

say:3:1620113003:1.text: Same with this canned fish I bought! Can you believe it's the premium version?
say:3:1620113003:1.source_cn: 我买的鱼罐头也是！你看，我买的还是加浓加香版本！

say:4:1620113004:1.text: Yesterday, I got home and had it for dinner. Yuck! I thought I was chewing on paper!
say:4:1620113004:1.source_cn: 结果昨天到家拆开一吃——呸！我还以为自己在嚼白纸！

say:7:1620113005:1.text: These two are complaining about the fresh meat and canned fish they bought.
say:7:1620113005:1.source_cn: 这两个人抱怨说，买来的鲜肉和鱼罐头虽然看着好好的，吃起...

say:8:1620113006:1.text: Hmm... any chance this is related to our case?
say:8:1620113006:1.source_cn: 感觉有些奇怪……会和我们的调查有关吗？

choice_prompt:9:1620113006.text: Hmm... any chance this is related to our case?
choice_prompt:9:1620113006.source_cn: 感觉有些奇怪……会和我们的调查有关吗？

say:10:1620113007:1.text: Professor Anathyme said she couldn't leave her grave, so it wasn't her.
say:10:1620113007:1.source_cn: 教授说她只能在墓碑附近活动，肯定不是她吃的。

say:11:1620113008:1.text: Which means... another ghost is wandering out there, and it could be our culprit!
say:11:1620113008:1.source_cn: 所以，还有一个幽灵在外游荡！说不定它就是那个犯人！

say:12:1620113009:1.text: A-Another ghost? I'm terrified of supernatural stuff...
say:12:1620113009:1.source_cn: 怎、怎么又来一个幽灵……这个调查，一定要涉及到我最害怕...

choice:9:0:1.text: They say even ghosts can eat...
choice:9:0:1.male: They say even ghosts can eat...
choice:9:0:1.female: They say even ghosts can eat...

choice:9:1:2.text: Food eaten by ghosts loses its flavor.
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 幽灵吃过的食物，会失去味道
choice:9:1:2.male: Food eaten by ghosts loses its flavor.
choice:9:1:2.female: Food eaten by ghosts loses its flavor.
